'''''Shind''''' worked as a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Controller/Legends|Controller]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] who was best friends with [[Fenig Nabon]]. When [[Gecee]]{{'s}} gang attempted to intercept Fenig after he was knocked unconscious by [[Ghitsa Dogder]]. Shind helped Fenig give clearance for takeoff whilst stalling Gecee{{'s}} ship, and flagging it for a customs inspection.<ref name="A Credit for Your Thoughts" />
